theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (σ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), (SlashAction.map (-(n : ℤ)) σ (fun z : UpperHalfPlane => MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -(z : ℂ)) (E z).val)) τ = MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -(τ : ℂ)) (((HeckeEis.binaryFormRepSL ℂ n) σ⁻¹) (E (σ • τ))).val
theorems.natural_summary: Set R = ρ(σ⁻¹)E(σ•τ) and j = cτ+d ≠ 0. Representation inversion and determinant one identify the substituted evaluation coordinates as j⁻¹(1,−τ). Degree-n homogeneity contributes j⁻ⁿ, which cancels the weight −n slash factor jⁿ. No differentiability or equivariance assumption is used.
